watch.summary: The creator compliments young Valorant pro player Erde, hyperbolically claiming he is an AI trained on all the greatest in-game leaders.

beats.what: Creator asks how Erde can be 18 years old, an IGL, and an insane fragger.
Creator jokes that Erde is AI trained on the best IGLs like Ethan, Boaster, and Boostio.
Creator concludes Erde is simply not human.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: That's AI. Man has been trained on all the greatest IGLs ever.
watch.why: This clip is esports hype commentary celebrating a player's talent rather than a comedy bit. The joke about the player being an AI trained on pro data is hyperbole used to deliver praise.
